buildCommand: npx convex deploy --cmd 'npm run build' && if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = preview ]; then npx convex env set --preview-name "${VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_REF}" SITE_URL "https://${VERCEL_BRANCH_URL:-$VERCEL_URL}"; fi && if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = production ]; then npx convex env set AUTH_PASSWORD_DISABLED true; fi
